Topics covered in this PDF

MSOE-105 (Introduction to Urban Sociology) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Urban sociology and its subject matter, defining urban in India, bases of defining a city, rural-urban continuum, ecological perspective
  • Exploitative model, social area analysis, the colonial city of Kolkata, trends of urbanisation in India, urban sociology in India

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: answer any five questions in about 500 words each, 20 marks each, maximum marks 100, weightage 30%
  • The cover prints the course code MSOE-105 but an assignment code beginning MSO-101; this is an unverified source inconsistency, so check your own assignment code

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
